pages.title: Bubble Pop Frenzy
pages.creator: Wuhan Yingyue Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Clear colored groups in Bubble Pop Frenzy by aiming bubbles into matching formations. Groups of at least three pop and can set off chain reactions. Earn rewards from the levels and use them to decorate rooms between shooting puzzles.

pages.title: Sweep Maze
pages.creator: Oddberry Studios
pages.description: Paint every open tile with a moving ball in Sweep Maze. Plan a route around blocked spaces so no accessible section is left uncovered. Choose a difficulty and use hints when you need help identifying the next move.

pages.title: Animal Klotski
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Free a pink rabbit from a crowded board in Animal Klotski. Slide the surrounding animal-shaped blocks to open a route to the exit. Each move changes the available space, making the order of your rearrangements central to solving the level.

pages.title: SCP 173 Escape
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Escape containment in SCP 173 Escape by moving only when nobody is looking. Hide from Foundation personnel and wait for patrols to turn away before advancing through the corridors. Use cover and timing to reach the exit without being captured.

pages.title: Floof My Pet House
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Look after cats and dogs in Floof My Pet House. Feed your pet, dress it up, and play minigames to earn coins. Spend the earnings on furniture and house improvements as you expand the animals' living space.

pages.title: Chicken Banana Quest
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Find a concealed play button in Chicken Banana Quest. Examine each puzzle and interact with its objects to uncover the solution before your lives run out. Try to complete the stages with fewer clicks as you help Chicken and Banana continue.

pages.title: Survival Island: EVO
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Gather supplies on a remote island in Survival Island: EVO. Collect food, water, wood, and stone to craft tools and build shelter. Maintain a fire and protect yourself from hunger and wildlife while exploring for resources and further crafting opportunities.

pages.title: 3Dash
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Jump through rotating three-dimensional tracks in 3Dash. Time inputs to the rhythm while dealing with sudden changes in perspective and direction. Complete six designed levels, then use the level editor to create additional courses of your own.

pages.title: Triangles
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fit geometric pieces into a hexagonal board in Triangles. Complete lines to remove blocks and earn diamonds, keeping enough space for later figures. Spend diamonds on helpful bonuses when the growing arrangement becomes difficult to manage.

pages.title: Traffic Parking
pages.creator: Depfov
pages.description: Guide a vehicle home in Traffic Parking. Inspect its route, clear rocks when necessary, and avoid the cars blocking the road. Tap once to preview the path and again to set the car moving toward its garage.

pages.title: Mystical Blade 3D
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Build a spinning battle top in Mystical Blade 3D. Combine blades, rings, and elemental parts to design your B-Blade, then take it into combat. Experiment with different component combinations as you compete against other players' creations.

pages.title: Countryside Driving Quest
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Explore rural roads in Countryside Driving Quest. Take on driving, parking, and drifting challenges across the countryside setting. Use the keyboard to steer and brake, adjusting your approach between tight parking positions and winding sections of road.

pages.title: Hostage Fishes
pages.creator: UznGames
pages.description: Repair an aquarium's filter network in Hostage Fishes. Reconnect the malfunctioning pipes before the one-minute limit expires and the fish are lost. Use the mouse to work through the layout and restore a functioning route through the system.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Free 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match colored groups without a countdown in Bubble Shooter Free 3. Aim bubbles into sets of at least three, swap the current shot with the next bubble, and use bombs for larger clearances. Plan placements to keep opening the board.

pages.title: Circle Run Endless
pages.creator: Gamecmn
pages.description: Keep a ring clear of the line running through it in Circle Run Endless. Tap to raise the circle and manage its height without touching the wire. Collect gifts during the run and use them to purchase alternative circles.

pages.title: Bhides English Classes
pages.creator: Neela Mediatech Private Limited
pages.description: Build English words from letters in Bhides English Classes. Choose a sequence of letters, check the resulting word, and reveal help when needed. The activity tracks found words as you work through its vocabulary challenges.

pages.title: Help The Hero
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Choose solutions to unusual problems in Help The Hero. Guide a young superhero through dangerous places by selecting between the offered actions, including choices with unexpected logic. Earn currency during play and spend it on additional masks for the character.

pages.title: Bubble Fish
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Collect the required number of colored bubbles in Bubble Fish. Aim shots to make matching groups and remove them from the board. Keep the formation away from the boundary while meeting the level's collection target.

pages.title: Street Car Race Ultimate
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Complete traffic-driving missions in Street Car Race Ultimate. Steer around obstacles and work through the objectives in each level. Collect coins to improve acceleration or buy a better car, expanding the vehicles available for later challenges.

pages.title: Dog Puzzle Story
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Join Charlie's garden adventure in Dog Puzzle Story. Swap pillows, toys, and treats to form matching groups of at least three items. Clear the puzzle objectives as the puppy continues through boards filled with dog-themed pieces.

pages.title: Flipman
pages.creator: Azerion
pages.description: Navigate a ghost-filled maze in Flipman. Collect the items along its passages and use apples to make the pursuing ghosts vulnerable. Plan your turns around the maze's walls while continuing the collection without being caught.

pages.title: Handmade Easter Eggs Coloring Book
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Design decorated holiday eggs in Handmade Easter Eggs Coloring Book. Pick an illustration and use the toolbar's pencils or brushes to add color. Build your own arrangement of shades and details to turn each outlined egg into a finished picture.

pages.title: Hover Skirt
pages.creator: IE Marat Giliazov
pages.description: Stack colorful dress sections in Hover Skirt to create a skirt that supports flight. Collect gems, keys, and fashion pieces while moving along the runway. Flying consumes the gathered skirt length, so build enough material before crossing gaps.

pages.title: Dart Tournament Multi player
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Compete against other dart players in Dart Tournament Multi player. Adjust a throw's angle by dragging, then release the dart toward the board. Work your score down to exactly zero before the opponent to win the match.

pages.title: Run Dude!
pages.creator: Straydog Studio
pages.description: Escape a pursuing dog in Run Dude!. Drag to change the runner's direction and find a route to the finish. Keep the dog from reaching him while managing the obstacles and the character's increasingly precarious clothing.

pages.title: Mini Market Tycoon
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Manage a growing grocery shop in Mini Market Tycoon. Serve its daily customers and reinvest earnings in new departments and upgrades. Hire helpers to handle more of the workload as the expanding supermarket creates further opportunities for income.

pages.title: Hexa 2048 Puzzle - Block Merge
pages.creator: BotaGame
pages.description: Combine numbered hexagons in Hexa 2048 Puzzle - Block Merge. Drag blocks into position and rotate them when needed to line up matching values. Identical blocks merge into larger numbers, making each placement part of building the next higher tile.

pages.title: Pyramid Exit Escape Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Free a sarcophagus from a crowded chamber in Pyramid Exit Escape Game. Slide stone blocks to open a path toward the exit. The puzzle asks you to reorganize the room without losing access to the spaces needed for later moves.

pages.title: Bouncy Race 3D
pages.creator: Tarek Mongy
pages.description: Race through a crowded course in Bouncy Race 3D. Dodge moving obstacles, collect speed boosts, and use trampolines to skip sections of track. Steer the landing marker while airborne so the jump returns you safely to the race.

pages.title: Pixel Wars Snake Edition
pages.creator: Crimson Games IO
pages.description: Collect souls to revive ancient fighters in Pixel Wars Snake Edition. Switch between the available heroes and attack enemies as you build the group. Bringing all the warriors back to life gives you the strength needed to defeat the snake.

pages.title: Touch Drawn
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Draw a footballer's route in Touch Drawn. Lead the player toward the goal while avoiding rival defenders and positioning teammates to support the move. Each level asks you to turn the team's arrangement into a successful attacking path.

pages.title: Zero Squares
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Slide colored tiles into their matching destinations in Zero Squares. Plan movements around the grid so every square reaches the right target. Reset the puzzle when your chosen route leaves the tiles stuck and try another sequence.

pages.title: Multiplication Roulette
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Practice arithmetic with spinning number wheels in Multiplication Roulette. Stop both roulettes, multiply the displayed values, and enter the answer as quickly as possible. Ten turns give you a sequence of multiplication questions chosen by the wheels.

pages.title: Water Sort Puzzle Color Sorting Game
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Separate mixed liquids in Water Sort Puzzle Color Sorting Game. Pour between glasses until each contains a single color, respecting both color-matching and space restrictions. Plan transfers around the empty capacity so the remaining water can still be sorted.

pages.title: Impostor Archer War
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Shoot enemy infiltrators in Impostor Archer War. Time arrow shots to hit the opposing characters and eliminate them from the encounter. Improve your abilities as you progress, using more effective shooting to handle the threats ahead.

pages.title: Easter Bunny Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore holiday animal pictures in Easter Bunny Slide. Choose one of three images and a three-, four-, or five-square grid. Rearrange the shuffled sections until the bunny scene forms a complete picture.

pages.title: Stacky Run
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Gather building materials during a run in Stacky Run. Collect bricks and diamonds on the platforms, using the bricks to make bridges between islands. Keep enough material for the gaps ahead so you can reach the finish safely.

pages.title: Stack Color
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Drop blocks into a growing tower in Stack Color. Time each placement so the next piece sits on the existing stack and keeps it standing. Use available power-ups to assist as you try to build the tower higher.

pages.title: Dental Care Game
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Treat animated patients in Dental Care Game. Examine their teeth and work through the provided dentist activities to address each problem. The characters react during treatment, giving the care sequence a more expressive presentation than a static dental model.

pages.title: Bread Pit 2
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Guide a bread slice toward a toaster in Bread Pit 2. Work through the puzzle layout and keep the character clear of protruding forks and knives. The objective is to reach the appliance safely and turn the bread into toast.

pages.title: Super Drag
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Time gear changes during head-to-head drag races in Super Drag. Use the transmission to maintain acceleration and beat the opposing driver. A selection of cars and a fast truck provide different vehicles for working toward victories across the races.

pages.title: Fruit Monster
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Teach a hungry creature about produce in Fruit Monster. Identify the displayed fruit and drag it into the monster's mouth. The activity connects feeding the character with learning the names of different fruits.

pages.title: Spot The Difference City
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Compare urban scenes in Spot The Difference City. Find at least five changes between each pair of nearly identical pictures. Click the alterations you notice and use a hint when a remaining detail is difficult to locate.

pages.title: Stack Ball 3
pages.creator: ArcadeGears
pages.description: Send a ball down a stacked tower in Stack Ball 3. Click to make it descend and break through the brick layers. Work toward reaching the bottom by choosing when to drive the ball through the stack.

pages.title: Cute Owl Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rearrange picture sections in Cute Owl Slide. Choose among three owl images and three puzzle modes, then restore the selected scene. Compare the markings and background across the scrambled pieces to find their proper positions.

pages.title: Brain Out
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Solve unconventional riddles in Brain Out. Click, hold, or slide elements around each scene to discover what the puzzle actually requires. Some solutions depend on moving beyond the obvious interpretation, making experimentation part of finding the answer.

pages.title: Smiley Shapes
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Create friendly geometric characters in Smiley Shapes. Choose a base such as a circle, triangle, square, or heart, color it, and add a face. Save finished designs in your collection and try another combination of shapes and expressions.

pages.title: Stack Twist
pages.creator: Gamearcade.org
pages.description: Smash colored platforms with a falling ball in Stack Twist. Hold the control to break through the twisting stack, but release before striking a black obstacle. Choose among the available balls and work your way down without hitting a dangerous layer.

pages.title: Offroad Motorcycle Bike Racing 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Ride across uneven terrain in Offroad Motorcycle Bike Racing 2020. Drive through every checkpoint on the map to complete a level. The challenge combines keeping the motorcycle under control with following the full off-road route at speed.

pages.title: Arkadium's Lumeno
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Connect matching lights in Arkadium's Lumeno. Draw through three or more same-colored balls, including diagonal neighbors, to clear them. Remove a Boss Ball to level up and earn more moves, extending the puzzle through further connected groups.

pages.title: Fun Snake
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Grow a creature by eating dots in Fun Snake. Guide the snake toward food while keeping it clear of enemy creatures. Each collection makes it larger, giving you an expanding body to manage as you continue across the play area.

pages.title: Japanese Food Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put food photographs back in order in Japanese Food Slide. Select one of three images and choose a puzzle mode before rearranging the sections. Restore the complete dish picture by comparing the details across its scrambled pieces.

pages.title: First Valentine Kissing
pages.creator: Gamer Games
pages.description: Help a couple share a discreet beach kiss in First Valentine Kissing. Keep the kiss going when nearby people are not looking and stop when someone watches. The timing challenge comes from balancing their romantic moment with avoiding discovery.

pages.title: Love Couple Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild romantic pictures in Love Couple Slide. Choose from three images and three puzzle modes, then rearrange the scrambled sections. Use the characters and background details to work out where each part belongs in the finished scene.

pages.title: Speed Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Speed Cars Jigsaw offers twelve vehicle pictures to assemble. Select a 25-, 49-, or 100-piece layout and put the sections back together. Each difficulty changes the amount of detail you need to sort while rebuilding the chosen car.

pages.title: Funny Kitty Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble illustrated cat scenes in Funny Kitty Puzzle. Six pictures offer four piece counts, ranging from sixteen to one hundred. Pick a layout and fit the pieces together to complete the image at your preferred difficulty.

pages.title: Builder
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Stack moving building sections in Builder. Time the drop so each new layer overlaps the tower below, avoiding excessive trimming from misaligned placements. Keep the available surface broad enough to continue constructing a taller building.

pages.title: Bomb Balls 3D
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Demolish structures with cannon fire in Bomb Balls 3D. Adjust the gun's direction and click to launch a shot into the arrangement. Keep targeting the remaining sections until the entire building has been brought down.

pages.title: Plane War
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Fight deeper into enemy airspace in Plane War. Shoot hostile aircraft while avoiding their bullets and collect weapons, fuel, and health for your plane. The ongoing flight asks you to balance attacking enemies with keeping the aircraft supplied and intact.

pages.title: Christmas Cookies Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Match seasonal sweets in Christmas Cookies Match 3. Form groups of at least three same-colored pieces to score while watching the gauge at the side. Continue finding matches before the meter drops low enough to end the game.

pages.title: Police Car Chase
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Steer a fast car through an escape run in Police Car Chase. Use the arrow keys to keep the vehicle moving and gather money along the way. Spend the collected funds on another car for later driving attempts.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Pumpkin Party
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help two friends prepare a seasonal celebration in Baby Hazel Pumpkin Party. Interact with Hazel, Jasmine, and their guests while organizing the event. Follow the party activities through preparations, games, and the food shared at the gathering.

pages.title: Dinosaurs Jurassic Survival World
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Survive among prehistoric predators in Dinosaurs Jurassic Survival World. Explore a dangerous forest, use firearms against dinosaurs, and manage your weapons during the encounters. Play a campaign focused on escaping or fight alongside a friend in multiplayer.

pages.title: Anti Stress Game 2
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Try a collection of small interactive activities in Anti Stress Game 2. Play with elements such as letters, bubbles, stones, and coloring tools. The game has no time or space restriction, letting you switch activities and experiment at your own pace.

pages.title: Mixer Trucks Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Find identical vehicle cards in Mixer Trucks Memory. Reveal pictures and remember their locations as you work through nine levels. The final arrangement contains fifty-two cards, making careful recall increasingly useful for matching all the trucks.

pages.title: EG Hot Jewels
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Swap gemstones to form matching groups in EG Hot Jewels. Drag a jewel into place and line up at least three matching pieces to clear them. Keep looking for productive exchanges as you try to increase your score.

pages.title: C Class Sedan Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reconstruct automobile images in C Class Sedan Puzzle. Six sedan pictures each offer layouts with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Choose a difficulty and fit the scattered sections together to restore the selected car photograph.

pages.title: Kick the Buddy
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Experiment with destructive tools on a ragdoll in Kick the Buddy. Select weapons and effects ranging from gunfire and explosives to freezing attacks. The game centers on seeing how the character reacts to the different ways you strike and damage it.

pages.title: Ball Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Keep a ball on descending platforms in Ball Challenge. Collect coins while moving downward, avoiding both falls and contact with the top edge of the screen. Continue landing on safe surfaces to extend the attempt for as long as possible.

pages.title: 100 Speed Bumps Challenge Simulation
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Test cars against repeated road humps in 100 Speed Bumps Challenge Simulation. Drive different supercars across a long sequence of bumps and observe how they handle the impacts. Adjust the camera as you experiment with the vehicle's speed and control.

pages.title: Shape Runner
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Guide a ball through an endless obstacle course in Shape Runner. Move left or right with the keyboard or swipe controls to choose its path. Keep the ball clear of obstacles while working toward a higher score.

pages.title: Banana Running
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Search city streets for a missing partner in Banana Running. Guide Mr. Nanners between lanes and beneath obstacles while collecting dolls and Banana Balls. Spend the collected balls on equipment upgrades that support later runs through the city.

pages.title: Sky Battle
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Fight airborne enemies in Sky Battle. Pilot your plane through incoming formations and fire at hostile aircraft, including bosses. Improve the plane's attack, armor, and speed as you work through the game's aerial combat encounters.

pages.title: Yatzy Friends
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Roll for scoring combinations in Yatzy Friends. Decide which dice results to keep and use the available categories to build your total. Compete against the game's Yatzy opponents, planning each choice around the combinations still open to you.

pages.title: Tower vs Tower
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race a friend to build a stable stack in Tower vs Tower. Drop cubes from a plane, align five of them, then place a pentagon on top. Balanced placement matters as both players try to complete the required tower first.

pages.title: Crush the Animals
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Rescue transformed creatures in Crush the Animals by matching their ball-shaped forms. Line up at least three of the same animal to remove them. Work quickly to gain a high score within the available time.

pages.title: Romantic Love Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Inspect romantic scenes in Romantic Love Differences. Find seven alterations between the paired pictures within each level's one-minute allowance. Ten levels give you new details to compare as you work to identify every change.

pages.title: Tennis Ball
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Return shots with a racket in Tennis Ball. Keep the rally going and watch the counter track your successful hits. Score as many points as possible in a single set to work toward beating the recorded high scores.

pages.title: First Day Of School Preps
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose school outfits for two sisters in First Day Of School Preps. Annie needs a look for second grade, while Rachel is preparing for college. Pick clothing that matches each school's requirements and get both sisters ready for their first day.

pages.title: Grindcraft Remastered
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Gather and craft resources in Grindcraft Remastered. Click inventory items to mine materials, harvest crops, and obtain supplies from hostile creatures. Turn those resources into further items as you progress through its block-world crafting challenges.

pages.title: City Stunts
pages.creator: AdoLuxGames
pages.description: Explore an urban stunt playground in City Stunts. Choose a sports car and use ramps and loops to launch over buildings or try landing on their roofs. The city provides space to experiment with different driving approaches and jumps.

pages.title: Rocking Wheels
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Get a touring band to its concerts in Rocking Wheels. Drive between thirty stops and handle the hazards along the way. Use the accelerator and brake to balance the vehicle as you hurry toward the next performance.

pages.title: Princess Mermaid Makeup Style
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Give an underwater princess a seasonal beauty look in Princess Mermaid Makeup Style. Choose colors for her makeup and coordinate the available cosmetic options. Experiment with combinations until you have completed the mermaid's summer makeover.

pages.title: Freddy's Escape House
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Escape a maze of rooms in Freddy's Escape House. Swipe to open doors and keep moving through the labyrinth as quickly as possible. Stronger scores unlock more characters, giving you additional choices for later escape attempts.

pages.title: Kids Tangram
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Form pictures from geometric pieces in Kids Tangram. Arrange the seven flat shapes so they combine into the required figure. Compare their angles and edges to work out how each piece contributes to the completed silhouette.

pages.title: Who wore it better – fashion battle
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Style two friends around a shared item in Who wore it better – fashion battle. Build one look with hip-hop influences and another with a bohemian approach. Add accessories that reflect each princess's preferences, then compare their interpretations of the same fashion piece.

pages.title: Bubble Pop Story
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear colorful bubbles within a limited number of moves in Bubble Pop Story. Choose groups to pop and work toward a high score before the move allowance is exhausted. Each selection matters to how much of the board you can clear.

pages.title: Winter Top Model Dress Up
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Prepare fashionable cold-weather looks in Winter Top Model Dress Up. Select outfits for the models and coordinate their styling choices. The wardrobe activity centers on putting together finished winter appearances for each of the characters.

pages.title: Romantic Spring Couple
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Dress two characters for a seasonal outing in Romantic Spring Couple. Choose their hairstyles, clothes, shoes, and accessories from separate wardrobes. Coordinate both looks and use the save or print options to keep the finished spring scene.

pages.title: Aria Baby Room Decoration
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Design a nursery in Aria Baby Room Decoration. Choose a crib and other furniture, then change details such as the floor, wall color, and window shape. Combine the available pieces to create a complete room for Aria's baby.

pages.title: Go Right
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Judge the distance between platforms in Go Right. Hold to prepare a box's jump and release to launch it toward the next landing. Keep calculating the required length as you try to carry the run farther.

pages.title: Box Jump Up
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Climb past hostile red blocks in Box Jump Up. Tap for a jump or double-tap to jump again, timing the movement to avoid enemies. The challenge is to keep ascending without striking one of the dangerous boxes.
